advisories.rationale: Transitive build dependency through the GTK/glib macro stack; it is not a direct application dependency.
advisories.revisit: Re-evaluate when the upstream GTK/Tauri dependency chain replaces proc-macro-error or removes the GTK3 macro stack.

advisories.rationale: Transitive through Tauri GTK3. The affected glib::VariantStrIter API is not referenced directly by src-tauri/src; RustSec patches this advisory in glib >=0.20, outside the current upstream GTK3 stack.
advisories.revisit: Re-evaluate if VariantStrIter becomes reachable in application code or when upstream Tauri supports glib >=0.20 / GTK4.

advisories.rationale: Transitive via tauri-plugin-single-instance 2.5.4 -> zbus 5.19.0. The standalone zvariant package is now unmaintained; no exploitable vulnerability is asserted.
advisories.revisit: Revisit when a supported stable tauri-plugin-single-instance release adopts zbus 6 wire APIs (or another supported maintained replacement); qualify single-instance Linux DBus and cross-platform GUI behavior.

advisories.rationale: Transitive via tauri-plugin-single-instance 2.5.4 -> zbus 5.19.0. zbus_names is an unmaintained standalone crate now consolidated into zbus 6.
advisories.revisit: Revisit when supported stable Tauri plugin dependencies move to zbus 6 name APIs; test DBus name registration, second-instance behavior and Linux/macOS/Windows GUI checks.

advisories.rationale: Transitive through zvariant 5.15.0 in the zbus 5.19.0 single-instance graph. The separate derive crate is unmaintained; zbus 6 provides the macros.
advisories.revisit: Revisit when the upstream stable single-instance dependency graph moves away from zvariant 5 to zbus 6; verify code generation and cross-platform GUI behavior.
